fields.headline: Unified command briefing: Marston Central High School
fields.summary: Units from three agencies are on scene. A single command post is staffed in the main office lot. Fire and EMS are staged at the south lot and a joint information center is being formed.

commandPost.location: Main office parking lot, Marston Central High School
commandPost.incidentCommander: Capt. Dana Reyes, Marston Police Department

agencies.role: Outer perimeter, traffic, county dispatch link
Medical care, transport and hospital destinations
Traffic on the highway, air support request

objectives: Keep one command post and one set of objectives for every agency on scene.
Fire and EMS lead medical care, transport and destinations; hospitals are notified of the count.
Open one reunification site before families arrive at the perimeter in large numbers.
Release one public message from the joint information center, with the same numbers from every agency.
decisionsNeeded: Approve the second reunification entrance and the staffing it needs.
Decide whether to ask the state for a second incident commander for the long investigation.
fields.issuedBy: Planning Section Chief, Lt. Marcus Bell

fields.headline: Mutual aid request to Harlan County Sheriff’s Office
fields.summary: Marston Police asks for deputies and a field supervisor to relieve units at the outer perimeter and to staff the reunification site. Report to staging and check in with the Staging Manager.
decisionsNeeded: Harlan County to confirm the response through the agreed channel and the number of units sent.

fields.headline: Staging and reunification site plan
fields.summary: Three sites are in use. Families go only to the reunification site; the media area is separate from both. Site managers report status to the command post every 30 minutes.

sites.name: Staging
sites.purpose: Arriving units check in and receive assignments

sites.name: Reunification site
sites.purpose: Parents and guardians meet students; victim services on site

sites.name: Family assistance
sites.purpose: Private area for families waiting for information

sites.name: Media area
sites.purpose: Briefings by the public information officer
sites.location: Corner of Mill Street and 5th Avenue

decisionsNeeded: Confirm that the district buses carry students only to the reunification site.
